latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Google Search via AceDataCloud API.

- Enables web, image, news, map, local place, and video searches using Google SERP.
- Supports localization by country and language.
- Includes time filtering and pagination options.
- Returns structured results: titles, snippets, URLs, knowledge graph, and more.
- Requires an ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN for authentication.
- Optional integration with mcp-serp for tool-based access.
